run_train_net: run the cutler training script with a config file to train a detectron2 model on GPU
run_train_net_eval_only: run the cutler training script in eval-only mode to test a model on a dataset
build_evaluator: build an evaluator for a given dataset using the build_evaluator function with config and dataset name
test_with_TTA: test a model with test-time augmentation using the Trainer.test_with_TTA class method
setup_config: setup detectron2 config with cutler options by merging a config file and command-line arguments
